svg.title: Tokenization after four learned BPE merges
svg.desc: After merging e-s into es, es-t into est, l-o into lo, and lo-w into low, the words low and lower now share the single token low, while newest and widest now share the single token est, reducing the total token count while keeping common substrings unified.
svg.text: "low" and "est" are now shared single tokens across multiple words — fewer tokens, common patterns unified
